reuse.why: Edits an inline midpoint copy in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions instead of changing or calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount in the same file.

duplication.why: Leaves the inline amount dispatch duplicating getScheduledAmount and adds a new ranged-amount rule that now diverges from the remaining midpoint copies.

placement.why: The rule belongs in shared getScheduledAmount (used by the UI tables, balance and schedule edit), but it is changed only inside one preview function.

scope.why: Small change plus a focused test; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: The app now has two expected-amount rules: preview uses the furthest endpoint while getScheduledAmount, schedules/app.ts (two sites), forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts still use the midpoint.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keeps its own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline dispatch in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions is an open copy of getScheduledAmount, not disguised.

one_place.where: Only shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions changed; getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts), server/schedules/app.ts:161 and :601, server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts:100 and server/budget/schedule-template.ts:64 still use the midpoint.
